ops.text: IV Licensee is referred to as Customer in this paragraph IV. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension thereof.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article IV locks us into a 36-month term with no exit right, so we added a Customer (Licensee) convenience termination on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Licensor has no convenience right during the committed term. We dropped the partial-termination and no-penalty wording as unnecessary.
proposal.summary: Insert Customer (Licensee) termination for convenience on 30 days' written notice with prepaid-fee refund, and no Licensor convenience right during the Initial Period.

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
